title: Repaired LTM unit scaling and narrowed SCS health cautions
points: Profit/loss LTM derivation now uses peer-aware unit selection before arithmetic, preventing mixed thousand/million headers from creating 1,000x P/E distortions.
SCS P/E remains an external spot check, but user-facing health cautions now exclude cases where SCS is explained by another clean reported basis such as an older annual or different section row.
Production D1 was refreshed for profit/loss rows, ratios, pipeline state, and quality flags; the database health matrix now has 427 green tickers, 44 yellow tickers, and 0 red tickers.
